guards: Exact unchanged selected sense/rendering/context only; no generated noun/verb/adjective forms or new answer words.
Retain source regional/register and plural-use labels; grammatical gender is raw source inventory, not independent certification.
Scientific names identify pinned source sense, not verified current taxonomy, species counts or medicinal advice.
Original erroneous/uncertain WordNet meanings stay held: CÍCERO unit is not pica and ABO/plant name scope not broadened by common names.
GAVIERO stays held pending sail/platform role resolution.
Source adaptations are original model English from Spanish Wiktionary CC BY-SA4, not English-dictionary quotations or native/Mexican teaching examples.
65 approvals are source decisions, not independently compiled new coverage.
